title: auth_ok
description: Authentication succeeded. Sent immediately for ingress/integration sessions, after 'auth' for paired clients. A repeated 'auth' on an authenticated session yields {type: auth_ok, message: 'Already authenticated'} without client_id. Always carries protocol_version, min_protocol_version and min_app_version.

protocol_version.description: Protocol version of the hub. An app that cannot speak it (hub too old for the app) shows 'update the hub'.

min_protocol_version.description: Lowest client protocol version the hub serves.
